integrity: The all-\(n\) statement is proved symbolically by an endpoint-state decomposition. Exhaustive computation through \(n=5\) and formula checks through \(n=12\) are finite consistency tests only and are not used as infinite certification. Prior minimum-number algorithms are not treated as evidence for the new coefficientwise enumeration. The first_public_date field records the earliest exact day-level public date verified in the checked sources; a month-only May 2016 index entry was preserved as uncertainty rather than converted to a fabricated day.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard symmetric barbell \(B_n\) for \(n\ge2\). It does not address unequal cliques, longer connecting paths, multiple bridges, roots of the enumerator, or asymptotic coefficient properties. Literature coverage can miss unindexed sources, and the checked block-graph optimization paper was available only through abstract/metadata in the accessible route. Date evidence has one month-only earlier signal (May 2016) without a verified day; the exact field uses the independently verified day-level public record 2016-10-01 rather than inventing a May date.
title: Double Roman weight enumerator of barbell graphs
